# bearing

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the angle between an entity's forward direction and a reference direction (typically north), in degrees.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:heading`](gmeow-heading.md) when both a facing and a relative bearing are meant.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:bearing`](gmeow-bearing.md) on the [`Orientation`](../classes/gmeow-Orientation.md); pair with [`gmeow:heading`](gmeow-heading.md) for the compass facet.

### Examples

- ex:ori [`gmeow:bearing`](gmeow-bearing.md) 45.0.
